requirements.text: Scenario renders a non-blank page comparable to the UWP golden (two buttons or an explicit visible fallback must be visible).
requirements.reason: Migrated content area renders fully blank/white in two independent captures. StatusText fallback is present in the UIA tree but not visibly rendered; VsToggleButton and VideoButton are anchored HorizontalAlignment=Right at x=1248 in a 1280-wide window and are clipped off the right edge.
requirements.suspected_skill_gap: The skill says defer CaptureElement and don't fake the type, and separately says swap to a visible fallback when init THROWS. It never tells the agent that a page whose hero control was DEFERRED (no throw) must carry a visible DECLARATIVE placeholder, so the page renders blank.

visual_discrepancies.uwp: Light-gray preview background with two visible overlay buttons (camera/VS toggle + red record ellipse) near the right edge, both disabled.
visual_discrepancies.winui: Fully blank white content area; fallback text not visible; buttons clipped at right edge.

missing_features: Visible page content after deferring the camera preview (blank render).
Camera preview, VS on/off toggle, video recording (deferred — no WinUI 3 desktop equivalent; matches UWP disabled state on a camera-less machine).
summary: Single-page camera sample. The unsupported CaptureElement was correctly deferred, but the substitute page renders blank: the fallback message is wired in OnNavigatedTo instead of a visible declarative placeholder, and the only static controls are clipped at the window edge. Blank render = scenario fail.
